messages:
tayler_cs: FYI Acme escalated — quantized endpoint rwd-quant-v2 is showing much worse latency than their FP16 baseline after last runtime deploy. p50 ~1.1x, p95 ~2x. They included a minimal repro and request ids.

tayler_cs: Repro (from customer):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/hosts/rwd-quant-v2/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \\
  -d '{"input":"summarize: ...","max_tokens":512, "use_kv_cache":true}'
```

alex_t: putting profiler on the customer's request id now (rid: rq_20260318_01). any quick checks they did?

tayler_cs: they said they compared with the same prompt to their FP16 endpoint and toggled batch size from 1->4. kv_cache=true for both tests.

maria_g: ran a local repro against our canary with the same request. profiler shows an extra dequantize/scaling op around layer 6 when kernel selection picks `int4_deqk_matmul_v2`. snapshot: 
```
[profiler] layer6: selected_kernel=int4_deqk_matmul_v2 time=18.4ms
[profiler] layer6: dequantize_op time=7.2ms
[profiler] layer6: matmul_fp16 time=11.2ms
vs fp16 path:
[profiler] layer6: fp16_matmul time=12.1ms
```
So quant path is doing dequantize + fp16 matmul vs direct int8 matmul on older models. that dequantize is the hit.

chris_r: that smells like kernel routing mismatch — runtime picks a dequantizing kernel when KV cache is present because it expects shorter sequences? also calibration hook might be inserting per-request scaling for tiny batches, creating extra ops.

samira: confirmed on my laptop: with KV cache warm and batch size 1, the kernel selector triggers the dequant path. If I disable kv cache the selector prefers `int8_matmul_v1` and p95 drops back to fp16 baseline.

alex_t: can we reproduce with a single curl? I want to try a few env toggles.

tayler_cs: customer tried disabling KV cache and said quant latency matches FP16. they asked for mitigation without disabling quantization.

maria_g: probable root cause: our kernel-cost model misestimates the cost when KV cache short-circuits attention path, causing selector to choose a kernel that needs dequant->fp16 fallback. Kernel metadata shows dequant path avoids a larger memory copy but pays for runtime cast ops. For small sequences that cast dominates.

chris_r: mitigation options:
- quick: add runtime flag to prefer matmul kernels that avoid per-layer dequant when kv_cache=true (hotfix).
- medium: update kernel-cost model to account for sequence_length + kv_cache_hot/warm heuristics.
- long: implement fused dequant_matmul kernels to remove extra op.

jen_oncall: prepping CS comms. ask them to try two toggles: `use_kv_cache=false` and `REDWOOD_QUANT_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=int8_matmul_v1` (we can inject via header for canary). also offer to roll back the runtime deploy if they prefer.

tayler_cs: they tried `use_kv_cache=false` and confirmed performance parity. they prefer a canary quickfix if possible.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started -> eng-runtime-canary with envflag `REDWOOD_QUANT_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=int8_matmul_v1` (deploy id: canary_1781234601).

chris_r: post-canary profiling (canary id) shows layer6 path now:
```
[profiler] layer6: selected_kernel=int8_matmul_v1 time=12.7ms
[profiler] total p95 request rq_20260318_01: 95ms -> baseline 48ms -> post-fix 50ms
```
Looks within noise of FP16 baseline.

samira: quick note — we should ensure this override doesn't regress throughput on large-batch high-throughput workloads. added a test in perf-harness to run a 64-batch run overnight.

jen_oncall: customer update drafted: "We identified a kernel-selection interaction with KV cache that caused an extra dequantization op for short sequences. We've rolled a canary that avoids that kernel and see p95 return to baseline. We'll monitor and follow up with a permanent fix." will send after ops confirm. :thumbsup:

tayler_cs: sending update to Acme now, will loop back with their feedback. thanks all for quick triage.

alex_t: opened GH issue rw/runtime#2345 with root cause notes and the perf traces. assigning to maria_g and chris_r for next steps.

maria_g: plan: 1) keep canary for 24h and monitor metrics 2) update kernel-cost model + add kv_cache hot/warm flag 3) schedule fused-kernel roadmap item.

tayler_cs: closing loop with customer once metrics stable.

deploy-bot: canary healthy at 10m, metrics show p95 back to baseline for customer traffic.

jen_oncall: archived thread in incident tracker, will attach transcript.
